definition: Classifying affect, arousal, and other speaker states from how something is said rather than what is said, part of the broader paralinguistics family (speaker traits, health signals).
details: Classifying affect, arousal, and other speaker states from how something is said rather than what is said, part of the broader paralinguistics family (speaker traits, health signals). Increasingly folded into speech LLMs that describe emotion and speaking style in natural language.
